# Duke Health

> Duke Health is a leading academic medical center and integrated health system serving the Triangle region of North Carolina with clinical care, research, and education programs.

Duke Health encompasses Duke University Hospital, regional medical centers, specialty clinics, and partnerships with Duke University School of Medicine and other academic institutions. The organization provides comprehensive patient care across multiple locations while advancing biomedical research and training the next generation of healthcare professionals.

## Key Topics

- Duke University Health System
- Duke University School of Medicine
- Clinical care and patient services
- Biomedical research
- Primary care

- [Strategic Planning Framework](https://corporate.dukehealth.org/who-we-are/strategic-plan): Duke Health strategic planning framework and 'Advancing Health Together' initiative.
- [Duke Health Leadership Teams](https://corporate.dukehealth.org/duke-health-leadership-teams-1): Executive directory and leadership structure of Duke Health and affiliated organizations.
- [Duke Health Leadership Team](https://corporate.dukehealth.org/chancellors-leadership-team): Duke Health executive leadership team and organizational administration.
- [Facts & Statistics](https://corporate.dukehealth.org/who-we-are/facts-statistics): Duke Health institutional statistics, rankings, funding, and organizational metrics.
- [History](https://corporate.dukehealth.org/who-we-are/history): Historical overview of Duke Health founding, James B. Duke, and institutional milestones.

- [Our Hospitals](https://corporate.dukehealth.org/clinical-care/our-hospitals): Duke Health hospital network including University Hospital, Regional, Raleigh, and Lake Norman.
- [Primary & Specialty Clinics](https://corporate.dukehealth.org/clinical-care/primary-specialty-clinics): Duke Primary Care and specialty clinic network locations across North Carolina.
- [Networks & Affiliates](https://corporate.dukehealth.org/clinical-care/networks-affiliates): Duke Health networks, partnerships, and affiliations including Duke LifePoint Healthcare.
